# Academic literature search strategy and paper analysis

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' research skill for navigating academic literature: formulating search queries with Boolean operators, PICO and concept mapping; choosing databases by field (Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, arXiv, IEEE Xplore, Scopus, Web of Science and more); the three-pass paper reading strategy (survey, understanding, deep dive); critical-analysis question sets; and ready-made output formats for search strategies and literature reviews with themes, methodology tables, research gaps and citation guidance (APA, IEEE, Chicago). Honest caveats: guidance only — it cannot run live database searches, read paywalled full text, or guarantee current citation counts; it also references the project's own office-mcp server (create_docx, extract_text_from_pdf) for document tooling, which you must have wired up to use; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
